_about: Server performance budget for the 8-bot bot test (tests/bot_test/perf_report.py). 'max'/'min' are hard limits: --perf-check fails past them. 'baseline' is what a healthy main measured; a metric in 'baseline_gated' fails when it is more than worse_ratio times its baseline, the others only print a note (CI machines differ in speed). Re-take the baseline when a note says a metric is well under it.
_taken: 2026-11-23, local 4-core run, 8 bots x 180 s WebSocket + Postgres: CPU 1.25 ms/tick (worst 5 s 2.49), 20.0 ticks/s, RSS 96.7 MB peak and flat, 60.5 kbit/s down and 43.0 up per player

max._why: A tick is 50 ms at 20 ticks/s. The average may use under a third of it and the worst 5 s under 70%, so the server has room for many more than 8 players before ticks slip. Memory and bandwidth ceilings are about 4x today's numbers: well under what Railway and a home connection allow.

min._why: Players feel a server that slips below 18 ticks/s as rubber-banding.
